authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9962 mahilā gives Hindi mihariyā and related mehar/mehrī woman, wife, with Gujarati merī. The survey meriya fits this contracted regional family; the article’s alternative prehistoric l/ḍ formations remain qualified. Exact survey form meriya is retained.
